glosses: At a stated distance in time or space.

examples.text: Christmas is only two weeks away.

glosses: In or to something's usual or proper storage place.

examples.text: I'll dry the dishes and you put them away.

glosses: In or to a secure or out-of-the-way place.

examples.text: The jewels were locked away in the safe.

glosses: Not here, gone, absent, unavailable, traveling; on vacation.

examples.text: The master is away from home.

examples.text: He's miles away by now.

glosses: Being the player whose ball lies farthest from the hole (or, in disc golf, whose disc lies farthest from the target).

examples.text: For example, immediately after every person in the group has teed off, if you are clearly the away player (perhaps because you smacked your drive into the tree closest to the tee pad), you should grab your bag and try to be the first person advancing down the fairway.

glosses: To depart; to go to another place.

examples.text: At 9 o'clock sharp he awayed to bed.
